The center write request:54 returns the created website object (response shape-5e03fa1138978d95ca693b5b exposes $.id, $.name, $.domain), and the following list read request:55 (shape-589a3d046f5f40452805abb9) exposes $.data[*].id. The identity linkage is a frozen hypothesis; no value-flow edge between request:54's response and request:55 was recorded.

POST /api/websites (request:54) carries the recorded create body name/domain and is bound to workflow-action-0004 (binding-0004); the user-websites list read request:23 before it and request:55 after it share the same catalog operation and selector, and ui-diff-0002 records the new 'Add test'/'addtest.com' row, so the created website object is proposed to be added to that collection.
